parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Method 1 — ignore the unbiased coin
$P(BH_1BT_2)=3/16$, $P(BT_1BH_2)=3/16$, $P(BH_1BH_2)=1/16$ [M1] All 3 different calculations seen unsimplified.
$P(B)=3/16+3/16+1/16=7/16$ [A1] Clear identification of all scenarios, linked probabilities and sum. AG.
Method 2 — include all three coins
Six cases: $3/32,3/32,3/32,3/32,1/32,1/32$ [M1] All 6 different calculations seen unsimplified.
$P(B)=(3+3+3+3+1+1)/32=7/16$ [A1] Clear identification of all scenarios, linked probabilities and sum. AG.
Method 3 — complement ignoring the unbiased coin
$1-P(BT_1BT_2)=1-(3/4)^2$ [M1] Calculation seen unsimplified and 1 minus probability seen.
$7/16$ [A1] Clear identification of scenario used, linked probability and calculation. AG.
Method 4 — complement with all three coins
$1-P(HBT_1BT_2)-P(TBT_1BT_2)=1-9/32-9/32$ [M1] Both calculations seen unsimplified and 1 minus 2 probabilities seen.
$7/16$ [A1] Clear identification of all scenarios used, linked probabilities and calculation. AG.
Total: 2
